mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that may prolong QT interval and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias, which fexofenadine may potentiate due to its own QT-prolonging potential.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly during foscarnet therapy; consider alternative antihistamine if electrolyte disturbances develop; perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring if combination is necessary.
